faq.q: Why use titanium for titanium derailleur pivot pin?

faq.q: How is a titanium derailleur pivot pin manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium derailleur pivot pin is manufactured using Hot forging; CNC turning; Thread rolling (DIN 13-1 / ISO 965-2, 6g). Each step is critical to achieving the required mechanical properties and dimensional tolerances.
